title: Bir Billing & Barot Valley
reportingPoint: Departure is in the evening from Delhi or Chandigarh. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip; report at the pickup point 30 minutes early.
overview:
Fly high in Bir, slow down in Barot: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** weekend trip leaves Delhi or Chandigarh in the evening in an AC deluxe vehicle for an overnight journey to Barot.

Day 1 explores Barot Valley: Lapas Waterfall, Batty House, the natural fountain and the Shanan Hydel Project dam with its riverside cafes. Day 2 visits the zero point of Barot and Rajgunda Valley, a hidden gem of meadows, wooden houses and Himalayan views, before moving to Bir. Day 3 is for the Billing paragliding take-off site (paragliding at own cost), Chokling Monastery and Bir's market and cafes before the evening departure; you reach Delhi early the next morning. Prices start at ₹7,000 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra); Christmas and New Year batches cost more.
highlights: Shanan Hydel Project dam with riverside cafes
Rajgunda Valley: meadows, wooden houses and Himalayan views
Billing paragliding take-off site (paragliding at own cost)

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi / Chandigarh
itinerary.content:
Assemble at the pickup point in Delhi or Chandigarh, meet your team captain and the group.
Depart in the evening for the overnight journey to Barot in an AC deluxe vehicle.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: Barot Valley | Lapas Waterfall | Shanan Hydel Project
itinerary.content:
Reach Barot, check in at the hotel, freshen up and rest for a while.
Explore Lapas Waterfall, then visit Batty House and the natural fountain.
See the Shanan Hydel Project dam, with cafes alongside.
Dinner, a bonfire and overnight stay at the hotel in Barot.

itinerary.title: Rajgunda Valley | Transfer to Bir
itinerary.content:
Freshen up and have breakfast.
Check out, visit the zero point of Barot, then explore Rajgunda Valley, a hidden gem of wide meadows, wooden houses and panoramic Himalayan views.
Depart for Bir.
Dinner and overnight stay in Bir.

itinerary.title: Bir Billing | Chokling Monastery | Departure
itinerary.content:
Wake up early and have breakfast.
Head to the Billing paragliding take-off site (paragliding at own cost).
Visit Chokling Monastery and Bir market, with free time for cafe hopping.
Evening departure; reach Delhi early the next morning.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: The trip leaves Delhi or Chandigarh in the evening for an overnight journey to Barot in an AC deluxe vehicle. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.

faqs.q: How much does the Bir Billing & Barot Valley trip cost?
faqs.a: On regular dates: ₹7,000 per person on quad sharing, ₹7,500 on triple and ₹8,000 on double. Christmas and New Year batches: ₹9,000 quad, ₹9,500 triple and ₹10,000 double. 5% GST is extra.
1 night in a Barot hotel and 1 night in Bir, 4 meals (2 breakfasts and 2 dinners), AC deluxe transport both ways, all sightseeing in the itinerary, a bonfire and music party and a tour curator.
No. Paragliding charges are not included. Day 3 visits the Billing take-off site, and you can fly at your own cost.
Night 1 is in a hotel in Barot and night 2 in Bir. Extra mattresses are provided for triple and quad sharing.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat with a ₹3,000 advance per person (UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking) and pay the rest 24 hours before boarding. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
The ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances. There are no refunds for inclusions you don't use, and bookings can't be transferred.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack a down or main jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, outdoor shoes, a daypack and personal medication. The full list is under Things To Pack.
